note: A headliner-heavy weekend: My Morning Jacket, Kronos Quartet and a free Fleet Week festival.

picks.reason: My Morning Jacket at The Fillmore — the weekend's biggest ticket, Saturday night.
Kronos Quartet with Mahsa and Marjan Vahdat at Bing Concert Hall, Sunday 2:30 PM.
Studio 54 dinner-and-dance party at the Verdi Club — drinks, dinner and a Saturday night floor.
SNL cast member Emil Wakim headlines Cobb's Comedy Club, Saturday 7 PM.
Free daytime festival at Chabot Space & Science Center — a low-cost Saturday out in the Oakland hills.
Electro legend The Egyptian Lover at DNA Lounge — Sunday night's best dance floor.
Soma Pilipinas Pride: Makibeki at SFMOMA — Saturday afternoon art and culture downtown.
